text: I'm looking for a new black Logitech H390 USB-A headset, the wired version. Can I buy it in stock from a Lebanese shop? Give me the listed price before delivery and the product link.

I carry my laptop between classes. I need a new Windows laptop with a screen no larger than 14 inches, at least 8 GB RAM and a 256 GB or larger SSD. Can you find an in-stock option at a Lebanese shop for USD 550 or less before delivery? Tell me why it fits and link it.

I'm buying a new Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+ with Wi-Fi only, 8 GB RAM and 128 GB storage. Any colour is fine. Which Lebanese shop has this exact version in stock, at what listed price before delivery? Please link the product.

I want a new Android phone for two phone numbers and lots of offline photos. I need dual SIM and at least 256 GB of built-in storage. My hard limit is USD 220 before delivery. Find one in stock from a Lebanese shop and give me the price, link and why it fits.
Can you find the new LG 24MR400-B monitor in stock at a Lebanese retailer? I want this exact model. Please link the listing and tell me the checked price before delivery.

I want a new tablet for reading sheet music and PDFs. I need a screen of at least 10 inches and at least 64 GB of internal storage. Wi-Fi is enough. What can I buy in stock at a Lebanese shop for at most USD 250 before delivery? Give me a link, the listed price and the relevant specs.

I want to buy a new Apple iPhone 15 128 GB from a Lebanese shop, but I must be able to plug my existing 3.5 mm headphones straight into the phone. I won't use an adapter or Bluetooth. If that version meets this requirement, give me an in-stock listing and price before delivery. If it can't, tell me why.

I'm after new wireless over-ear headphones for long study sessions. They must have at least 40 hours of rated playback on one charge. I can spend up to USD 80 before delivery. Recommend an in-stock pair at a Lebanese shop, explain the fit, and include the price and product link.
